scripts.gen:proto: cd proto && buf generate --template buf.gen.ts.yaml && buf build -o ../packages/protocol/descriptor.bin
scripts.build:worker: cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml && mkdir -p bin && cp rust/target/release/mentro-worker bin/mentro-worker.tmp && mv bin/mentro-worker.tmp bin/mentro-worker
scripts.spellcheck: cspell --no-progress --no-summary rust/crates apps/server/src apps/web/src proto docs
scripts.spellcheck:collect: cspell --words-only --no-progress --no-summary rust/crates apps/server/src apps/web/src proto docs | sort -u
